project.name: Daily Tasks
project.description: A lightweight to-do app for tracking a personal daily task list with reminders and simple categories.
project.problem: People juggle tasks across sticky notes and multiple apps and lose track of what matters each day.
goals: See today's top priorities at a glance
successCriteria: A user can add a task in under 5 seconds and see it grouped by category
userStories: As a student, I can add tasks and mark the three most important for today.

features.name: Daily top-3 view
features.description: Surface the three highest-priority tasks for today.

requirements.title: Users can create and complete tasks
requirements.description: Tasks have a title, optional category, and a done state.

requirements.title: Task list loads in under a second
requirements.description: The home screen must feel instant on 3G.

decisions.decision: Each task is a row with an optional user_id; no separate projects table for v1.
decisions.reason: Keep v1 simple; a single daily list is the core value.

security.accessControl: Each user sees only their own tasks.

acceptanceCriteria: Tasks persist after reload and are grouped by category
